title: A rebuilt homepage
summary:
A homepage rebuild refreshed the image tools and community sections, while a follow-up restored the public routes that point to them.

The homepage gained responsive layouts, new visuals, community and supporter sections, and expandable news. It also moved to React 18 and MUI 6.

The image feed and editor, integration examples, project listings, and LLM-based text transformations were reworked as part of the frontend overhaul.

Missing website files restored redirects from /prompt/* and /p/* to the image prompt endpoint, along with site routing, a web-app manifest, and crawler and funding files.

highlights.title: A new homepage
highlights.text: Explore a rebuilt, responsive homepage with community and supporter sections and expandable news. [Visit Pollinations](https://pollinations.ai).
